title: UltimateChatTool
body:
*Advanced chat management with colors, mutes, and global/local channels.* --- # ATTENTION! SUPPORT OF THIS PLUGIN IS CURRENTLY [PAUSED]. Why? i haev legal troubles so uhhh sowwy :3 --- ### **Features** - **Smart Chat**: `!global` for server-wide, normal messages for local (100 blocks) - **Rich Colors**: Supports `�FF00` (HEX) and `&c` (legacy) in all messages - **Moderation**: `/mute [time]` with customizable reasons - **Seamless Integration**: Works with Vault prefixes and PlaceholderAPI ### **Installation** 1. Install **[Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)** and **[PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)** 2. Drop UCT into `plugins/` 3. Restart server ### **Config Preview**
```yaml chat: local-radius: 100 format: "{prefix}{player}&7: {message}" colors-enabled: true mute: default-reason: "Spam" ```
### **Commands** - `/uct reload` - Reload config (requires `uct.admin`) - `/mute 30m Spam` - Temp mute (requires `uct.mute`) ### **Compatibility** - **Minecraft**: 1.21+ - **Servers**: Paper, Spigot - **Dependencies**: Vault, PlaceholderAPI *Clean. Powerful. No bloat.*
